title: Natural surface-connected-front to groundwater-contact transition authority
purpose: Determine whether D29 can be followed by a contact-capable long-window FMC experiment without inventing state-transition semantics.

predecessor.D19: Qualified an exact-contact falling-slug to groundwater-front representation merge followed by 64 zero-top-flux groundwater-relaxation steps.
predecessor.D20: Qualified the separated connected-surface plus fixed-water-table branch for one hour under continued prescribed infiltration.
predecessor.D29: Showed that every frozen one-day separated-branch history reaches surface-groundwater contact at step 927 (2.575 h), before any new R16/R2 exposure.
predecessor.D28: Established that the preferred M2WC70 implementation oracle is identified but currently not retrievable through available execution routes.

primary_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
explicitly_defined: four FMC water-state classes: surface-connected infiltration fronts, falling slugs, groundwater fronts, and gray bins connected simultaneously to land surface and groundwater
theta_i is the right-most bin connected to both land surface and groundwater; infiltration fronts span from theta_i to the right-most wetted bin
surface water first satisfies the demand of groundwater-connected gray bins, expressed through K(theta_i)*dt, before advancing infiltration fronts
falling slugs that encounter groundwater fronts are merged into the groundwater front by raising that front by the slug length
groundwater-front Eq.21 evolution and capillary relaxation are finite-volume mass conservative when implemented correctly
the method is intended as a continuous model under arbitrary surface forcing and groundwater effects
not_unambiguously_specified_in_prose_for: within-step event localization when an actively surface-connected infiltration front and an actively evolving groundwater front first meet
the exact finite-volume update when z_j + H_j crosses the column depth during a step rather than beginning at exact contact
the exact update of the right-most gray index theta_i when one or several new bins become surface-to-groundwater connected
ordering of remaining surface-water allocation, gray-bin throughflow demand, groundwater-front advance and relaxation over the unused fraction of the contact step
handling of multiple same-step contacts and any cascading change of theta_i
whether the authors split the process step at contact, cap the two fronts to exact contact before conversion, or use another mass-conservative event ordering
primary_authority.conclusion: The paper identifies the physical post-contact state and its subsequent governing ingredients, but does not define the D29 natural within-step transition algorithm tightly enough for a faithful clean-room trajectory implementation.

D19_scope.contact_type: falling slug begins at exact same-bin contact with groundwater front

D29_scope.contact_type: surface-connected infiltration front meets same-bin groundwater front during continued prescribed infiltration
D29_scope.contact_time: inside the frozen 10-second step that ends at step 927

repository_authority.authority_gap: D19 does not authorize substituting its falling-slug exact-contact transition for the D29 connected-front natural contact event.

implementation_oracle.preferred: University of Wyoming DataCorral M2WC70 authors' C implementation for Ogden et al. 2015
implementation_oracle.intended_use: Read-only semantic oracle to disambiguate event ordering; no external source code is to be copied into SWAP5.

allowed_next_when_oracle_available: record immutable M2WC70 archive provenance and digest
inspect only the surface-infiltration/groundwater-contact state-transition and time-step ordering routines needed to disambiguate the natural contact event
write a clean-room event/state-transition specification without copying external source into SWAP5
preregister a microscopic natural contact-event preflight before any long-window R16/R2 trajectory
only after the microscopic event closes may a contact-capable D29 successor long-window experiment be proposed
stopping_condition: Long-window contact-capable FMC research is externally blocked until M2WC70 or an equally authoritative implementation description resolves the natural surface-front/groundwater-contact event update.
